s.g: (US, military, initialism, slang) An Iraqi police officer, or the Iraqi police as a whole.

ip.f: (law, countable, uncountable) Initialism of intellectual property.

s.g: (linguistics, countable) A transcription written in the International Phonetic Alphabet.
(computing, countable) A kind of archive containing a software package for certain Apple devices. Originally an initialism of iPhone Archive, later redefined as iOS App Store Package.

ipa.f: (organic chemistry, uncountable) Initialism of isopropyl alcohol.

s.g: (trademark) A lightweight low-power tablet computer of a particular range from Apple Inc.
s.x: He was watching a movie on his iPad.

s.g: (by extension) Any lightweight low-power tablet computer.
(pharmacology) A growth hormone–releasing hormone analogue.

ipc.f: (chemistry, physics) Initialism of integrated physics and chemistry.

ipe.f: (political economy) Initialism of international political economy.

(pharmacology) An emetic and expectorant drug that contains emetine and is prepared from ipecac especially as a syrup for use in treating accidental poisoning.
The shrub that produces ipecac (Cephaelis ipecacuanha), native to Brazil and cultivated elsewhere.
(medicine, pharmacology) The root of Carapichea ipecacuanha, used as an emetic or purgative; a preparation of this root used as a drug; ipecac.
(medicine, pharmacology) The flowering plant Carapichea ipecacuanha.

iped.f: Initialism of image- and performance-enhancing drug.

ipex.f: Acronym of immunodysregulation polyendocrinopathy enteropathy X-linked syndrome (“a rare autoimmune disease”).

s.g: (trademark) A smartphone of a series produced by Apple, which typically combine a camera phone, PDA, multimedia player, and wireless communication device.
s.x: His mom bought him an IPhone for his 11th birthday.

s.g: (by extension) Any knockoff or similar high-end smartphone; through trademark genericization.
The long-tailed pangolin (Manis tetradactyla)

ipi.f: Initialism of interested party information (“an international identification system for people involved in creating or publishing musical works”).

(trademark) A portable music player made by Apple.
(by extension) Any portable personal MP3 player or similar device.
(botany) Any of various twining plants of the genus Ipomoea with showy monopetalous flowers, including the morning glory, the sweet potato, and the cypress vine.
The tuber of any one of several edible species of Perideridia spp.

ippa.f: (medicine) Initialism of inspection, palpation, percussion and auscultation: the four main steps of a physical examination.

s.g: (martial arts, judo) The highest score in judo, awarded for a throw that places the opponent on their back with impetus or for holding the opponent on their back for a number of seconds.

ipsc.f: (biology) Initialism of induced pluripotent stem cell.

s.g: (anatomy, medicine) On the same side of the body.

iptg.f: (organic chemistry, biochemistry) Abbreviation of isopropyl β-D-1-thiogalactopyranoside.
